def read(name):

    assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink()
    return json.loads(path.read_bytes())

assert (x['positive_count'],x['refusal_count'])==(5,34)

assert x['installed_external_allowlist']=={'numpy':'2.3.3'}
assert x['isolated_numpy_version_required']=='2.3.3'
assert len(x['every_entry_imported'])==12 and x['actual_waiter_imported'] is True
assert x['native_executed'] is False and x['numerical_functions_executed'] is False
x=read('admission')
assert x['status']=='PASS_ACTUAL_TAIL_LOADED_METADATA_AND_REGULAR_INVENTORY_CONTROLS'
assert len(x['positive_groups'])==4 and len(x['rejected'])==45
assert x['complete_actual_JSON_used'] and x['frozen_pipeline_validator_executed_on_saved_report']

assert x['actual_restore_exact_extract_pack_and_authorize_called'] is True
assert x['real_current_reports_validated_before_synthetic_archive_cases'] is True
assert x['producer_archive_downloaded'] is False and x['loaded_numerical_functions_executed'] is False
x=read('worker')

assert x['derivation']['edits']==x['derivation']['numerical_blocks']==6

assert len(x['terminal']['cases'])==7 and x['terminal']['positive']==1 and x['terminal']['failure_paths']==6

assert x['publication']['file_list_controls']['actual_shared_function_executed'] and not x['publication']['release_creation_possible']

import ast,base64,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
source=Path('scripts/cloud_cdr_v59_binding_rc.py')
assert source.is_file() and not source.is_symlink()
raw=source.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='647af19c78158045739b2589d61a2962bbff69e230b593ccb33019550edbd709'
nodes=[n for n in ast.parse(raw.decode()).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='emit']
assert len(nodes)==1
scope=dict(base64=base64,hashlib=hashlib,json=json)
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),str(source),'exec'),scope)
root=Path('hw/soc/out/cdr-v59-tail-loaded-controls')
assert not root.is_symlink() and (not root.exists() or root.is_dir())
names=('imports','admission','restore','worker','result','outer','runtime','release')
assert len(names)==len(set(names))==8
emitted=[];missing=[]
for name in names:
    path=root/(name+'.json')
    assert not path.is_symlink()
    if not path.exists():
        missing.append(name)
        continue
    assert path.is_file()
    scope['emit'](path,'CDR_TAIL_LOADED_CONTROL_'+name.upper())
    emitted.append(dict(name=name,bytes=path.stat().st_size,sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
print('CDR_TAIL_LOADED_CONTROL_CENSUS '+json.dumps(dict(emitted=emitted,missing=missing,missing_files_created=False),sort_keys=True),flush=True)

import hashlib,json,os
from pathlib import Path
case=os.environ['LOADED_CASE'];prepare=os.environ['PREPARE_ONLY']=='true'
cases=('nominal_early','nominal_late','hot_early','hot_late','cold_early','cold_late','constant_zero','constant_one','clock_stopped','vi_bias_off')
assert case in cases and (not prepare or case=='nominal_early')
suffix='preparation'if prepare else case
out=Path('cloud-cdr-v59-tail-loaded-evidence-'+suffix)
assert not out.is_symlink()
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
path=out/'result.json'
assert not path.is_symlink()
if not path.exists():
    outputs={}
    for member in out.rglob('*'):
        assert not member.is_symlink()
        if member.is_dir():continue
        assert member.is_file()
        with member.open('rb')as stream:
            outputs[str(member.relative_to(out))]=hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()
    value=dict(status='FAIL_BEFORE_LOADED_DRIVER_RESULT',source_head=os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],
      run_id=int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID']),run_attempt=int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']),
      case=case,preparation_only=prepare,group='cdr-v59-tail-loaded-'+suffix,
      fresh_RC_run=40576801174,original_physical_run=40369539200,
      original_physical_status='FAIL_ADDITIVE_TAIL_WIRE_PHYSICAL',
      original_eight_electrical_rejections_and_two_fault_detections_preserved=True,
      native_case_passed=False,accepted=False,qualified_pex=False,full_phy_accepted=False,
      cdr_accepted=False,physical_accepted=False,geometry_regenerated=False,
      native_extraction_executed=False,automatic_retry=False,
      terminal_finalization_complete=False,outer_terminal_finalization_complete=False,
      outputs=outputs,pre_driver_failure_marker_only=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
